ValidationRule.description: Restricts editing of Lead records once their Status is set to Lost, except for System Administrator and Utkarsh Admin profiles.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISNEW()), OR( ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status), "Lost"), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status), "Qualified") ), NOT(ISCHANGED(Status)), NOT(ISCHANGED(OwnerId)), NOT(ISCHANGED(Department_Name__c)), NOT(ISCHANGED( InQualificationProcess__c )), $Profile.Name <> "System Administrator", $Profile.Name <> "Utkarsh Admin" )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Lost or Qualified Leads can only be edited by System Administrator and Utkarsh Admin profiles.
